name: What information do I need to prepare before signing a flexible listing agreement?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to prepare before signing a flexible listing agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing, gather all relevant property details, including any recent appraisals, inspection reports, and a clear understanding of your desired selling price and timeline. It’s also crucial to define your expectations for agent services and marketing efforts. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution recommends clearly outlining your non-negotiables regarding communication, showing schedules, and how you plan to handle potential buyers you source yourself, ensuring mutual understanding before committing to the agreement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare property details, desired selling price, timeline, and clearly define your expectations for agent services and self-sourced buyers.
